title: wkappbot-system-total-check
steps: 1. EYE: wkappbot eye tick -- check ctx%, active sessions, isolation. Sessions at 170%+ need immediate newchat. 2. GIT: git log --oneline -5 (recent commits), git status --short (uncommitted). Any .cs/.yaml uncommitted = commit immediately. 3. CI: gh run list --limit 5 -- find failing workflows. AI News Collect failures: run scripts/ai-news-briefing.sh manually to diagnose. 4. ISSUES: gh issue list --repo kiexpert/WKAppBot --limit 10 -- identify blockers. win-capture GPU-render issue is ongoing. 5. SUGGESTS: wkappbot suggest list -- prioritize star 3+ or freq over 100/hr. WkAutoQuant-channel suggests need co-resolve from that session. 6. SCHEDULE: wkappbot schedule list -- verify AI News 11:00/18:00 recurring jobs exist and last ran OK. 7. CHROME: check bin/wkappbot.hq/chrome-profile/Default/Login Data exists (login persists). 8. AUDIO: ls bin/wkappbot.hq/profiles/whisper_exp/*.mp3 -- delete or commit pending audio files.

YOUTUBE RSS STATUS (2026-04-30): YouTube feeds/videos.xml returns 404/500 intermittently -- YouTube server issue, not config. Channel IDs in ai-news-channels.jsonl may also be stale. Workaround: script falls back to HN-only. Monitor: python3 -c 'import urllib.request; urllib.request.urlopen("https://www.youtube.com/feeds/videos.xml?channel_id=UCXuqSBlHAE6Xw-yeJA0Tunw", timeout=5)' -- if works, re-verify channel IDs.
